newsitem.title: UK: Rank plans 1.5 bln stg investment on UK leisure sites.
newsitem.headline: Rank plans 1.5 bln stg investment on UK leisure sites.

text.p: Rank Group plc said on Thursday it planned to spend 1.5 billion stg over the next four to five years on U.K. leisure sites.
At a press conference, Rank said its Leisure Division plans to invest over 300 million pounds a year every year for at least the next four to five years in developing new trading opportunities.
The division's targets are to open approximately 40 new locations a year in addition to a large reinvestment programme for existing properties.
Rank is the U.K.'s largest leisure company with more than 300 sites including Mecca bingo clubs, casinos, Odeon cinemas, night clubs and theme bars.

David Flowers, director of Rank Leisure's property and development department, said the company aims were to open 60 more bingo clubs, 15 casinos, 30 cinemas, 25 nightclubs and 50 theme bars throughout the UK over the next five years.
